name: Godrej Trilogy
address: Off Dr Annie Besant Road, near Mahalaxmi Racecourse and the Coastal Road (Lotus Colony), Worli, Mumbai 400018
description: A three-tower ultra-luxury redevelopment on a 2.63-acre parcel off Annie Besant Road, Worli, next to Mahalaxmi Racecourse, with racecourse and Arabian Sea views. Phase 1 covers two towers, Seaturf and Seafront, with about 11 lakh sq ft of saleable area. Godrej expects the whole project to earn over Rs 10,000 crore. It launched in November 2025 and sold homes worth over Rs 2,000 crore (nearly 100 homes) in Phase 1 by early February 2026.
notes: MahaRERA: Seaturf (Tower A, PR1171012501267) has 91 units, 47 floors (32 habitable) and completion 31 Dec 2033. Seafront (Tower B, PR1171012501309) has 166 units, 82 floors (66 habitable) and completion 31 Dec 2034. Both show about 1% construction progress (excavation 8%) on the Square Yards MahaRERA snapshot. Housiey shows 25% as of 4 Oct 2026 and a target of Dec 2031, which looks optimistic. total_units = 91 + 166 for Phase 1 only; the third tower is not yet registered. possession_promised is the later (Seafront) date. Promoters on MahaRERA: Embellish Houses Pvt Ltd and Akshay Sthapatya Pvt Ltd; the project is a joint redevelopment and the landowner was not named in the sources read. Units sold: Square Yards' MahaRERA snapshot (read 18 Nov 2026) shows Seaturf 55 sold + 10 booked and Seafront 43 sold + 28 booked, so units_sold = 136 sold or booked. Floor counts conflict: Square Yards says 44 and 77 floors, Guptasen G+43 and G+76, and Housing.com 32 floors for Seaturf; MahaRERA totals are 47 and 82. Land: 2.63 acres (Godrej / PTI), 2.61 (Housiey), 2.17 (Square Yards). Godrej's Q3 FY26 presentation reports 0.31 mn sq ft booked for Rs 1,742 crore in the launch quarter, about Rs 56,200/sq ft on Godrej's reported (saleable) area. Registered carpet rates in Jan-Jun 2026 are Rs 80,000-125,000/sq ft, rising with floor and tower (Seafront higher than Seaturf), so the implied gap between carpet and reported area is large. A ghar.tv broker post lists 10 deals from 25 Mar to 2 Apr 2026 at about Rs 82,000-108,000/sq ft (unnamed data source), with floors 18-25 at Rs 82-90k and floors 33-38 at Rs 95k-1.08 lakh. No published floor-rise schedule was found. Mumbai Property Exchange's developer copy names Hafeez Contractor as architect, but this was not confirmed. A May 2026 report of a Godrej family member buying two Worli apartments for Rs 294 crore did not name this project, so it is not attributed here.
